subject: HealthNova — Confirmation on LLM learning prohibition and log retention
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@healthnova.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Feb 2028 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: HealthNova — Follow-up from today's product call (data handling items)

Elena — thanks for taking time today. Quick recap and next steps from our end: 

- Summary: you confirmed HealthNova will evaluate Redwood for chat/assist features in clinical admin workflows. Main gating items were explicit: no model improvements from customer data, EU log residency for sensitive records (where applicable), and 30-day ephemeral logs for debug traces.

- Action items we captured:
  1) Redwood to provide a short addendum that prohibits training on customer data and documents our log-retention options (we've attached a draft).
  2) HealthNova to confirm whether the 30-day retention window should be applied globally or only for EU traffic.
  3) Exchange SOC2 evidence and compliance contacts (we attached a SOC2 summary).

Attached: Redwood_Data_Handling_Addendum_v1.pdf (stub), SOC2-Summary-Redwood.pdf (stub)

Can you confirm the training opt-out wording below matches exactly what you need? If so, we'll send a formal addendum for signature and lock the model variant to a non-tuning runtime.

Requested wording (candidate): “HealthNova data will not be used to improve, fine-tune, or otherwise update Redwood Inference models. Redwood will process requests for inference only and will not persist training datasets derived from HealthNova input beyond agreed logging retention windows.”

Also looping Jonas (security) and Aditya (solutions) — Jonas, can you confirm the operational controls (no retention of user-level training corpora, KV cache eviction policy, and a configurable 30d/90d retention toggle) are implementable for the initial pilot?

Thanks —
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 415-555-0197

From: Elena Park <elena.park@healthnova.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: HealthNova Security Team <security@healthnova.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Feb 2028 09:07:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: HealthNova — Follow-up from today's product call (data handling items)

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the clear notes. A few clarifications from HealthNova's side: 

- Confirmed: we require that Redwood not use any HealthNova data for model training or improvements. Wording looks good but we need the phrase “no use for model training, evaluation, or benchmarking” added explicitly.

- Retention: apply the 30-day ephemeral retention by default; for EU-subject records we need residency in EU region and a 14-day default retention. We may request longer retention for audit artifacts but that will be by exception.

- Audit evidence: please attach the specific SOC2 sections that describe data access controls and log collection (the generic summary is fine to start).

- Signing: we'd like the addendum to be included as an exhibit in the MSA. Can you route a draft to our legal once you have the final language?

Elena
Director, Platform & Security
HealthNova
elena.park@healthnova.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Elena Park <elena.park@healthnova.com>
Date: Thu, 23 Feb 2028 11:33:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: HealthNova — Follow-up from today's product call (data handling items)

Jonas / Aditya — forwarding HealthNova's clarifications. Key asks:

- Add explicit phrase: “no use for model training, evaluation, or benchmarking.”
- Implement differential retention: default 30d globally, 14d for EU-subject records (residency requirement).
- Provide SOC2 excerpts for data access controls/logging.

Jonas: Are we comfortable with the exhibit language and the operational knobs? Any blockers for pilot timeline (launch in early March)?

Aditya: can you prepare a one-page summary of how we would lock a model variant to non-tuning runtime + how KV cache eviction works (for Elena's team to review)? I can attach both to the addendum before routing to HealthNova legal.

Thanks —
Marissa

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@healthnova.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, HealthNova Security Team <security@healthnova.com>
Date: Fri, 24 Feb 2028 09:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Confirmation: HealthNova LLM-learning prohibition & retention exhibit (next steps)

Elena — thanks for the quick turnaround. Per today's internal review (Jonas confirmed controls) and Aditya's draft note, we can accommodate HealthNova's asks. Summary and next steps below: 

- Final wording to be included in the addendum (we'll send final PDF for signature):
  “HealthNova data shall not be used for model training, model evaluation, or benchmarking of Redwood Inference models. Redwood will process requests for inference only and will not persist datasets derived from HealthNova inputs for the purpose of model improvement.”

- Retention/residency: default 30-day retention for non-EU traffic; EU-subject records will be stored in our EU region with a 14-day default retention window. Exceptions require an authorized change order and will be recorded in the audit trail.

- Operational controls confirmed by Redwood: non-tuning runtime lock (model pinned to inference-only mode), KV cache eviction on session termination, and no background aggregation of HealthNova text into training corpora. Jonas attached a short checklist and Aditya attached the non-tuning runtime note.

Attachments: Redwood_Data_Handling_Addendum_v1.pdf (stub), HealthNova-QuickChecklist.xlsx (stub), SOC2-Summary-Redwood.pdf (stub)

Next steps:
  1) Redwood to update addendum with final wording and send formal exhibit for HealthNova legal (target: Monday 2028-02-28).
  2) HealthNova legal to review and confirm signature routing.
  3) Pilot config: default retention toggles to be set before pilot start; Aditya will share runtime lock instructions.

If that matches, I'll route the exhibit to your legal contact and create a HubSpot task under deal HN-2028-03-RI-57.

Best —
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
